AmiSSL-Tunnel on the A4000 (Roadshow) — quick update steps
===========================================================
Daemon is LIVE: 192.168.50.34 port 8443  (pi4k, systemd service
"amissl-tunnel" — starts whenever the A4000/TF4060 is powered).

The libs on this share are the TUNNEL build (b21-dup2) — they replace
any older Model-B / probe builds still in LIBS: from the May sessions.

From a Shell on the A4000, CD into this drawer (A4kAmiSSL), then:

  Copy amissl.library       LIBS:
  Copy amisslmaster.library LIBS:
  SetEnv SAVE AMISSLPROXY 192.168.50.34:8443
  ; (SYS:AmiSSL rename + assign removal was already done in May)

COLD BOOT, then in iBrowse / AWeb open:  https://aminet.net

What to expect in the daemon log (I can watch it live from here):
  CONNECT aminet.net:443 -> handshake -> relay
Full page + all inline images should load; downloads too.

If anything misbehaves: the old libs are still on this share under
old-modelB/ — copying them back + cold boot restores the previous state.
